addons.name: Berry web dashboard
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Looks for the Berry dashboard on the connected host and, when it is not there, installs src/www_rasconf from GitHub over SFTP: a backup, the files, the theme this program is wearing, the uhttpd section written with uci, the exec bit on the CGI entry, a restart and a check that the page answers. Also views and edits those options, finds which folder on the device holds the page, and can move that one to /www_berry - an install left in /www_rasconf by an older setup included. The page it finds is shown inside the tab, with a side bar back to the forms and on to a browser.

addons.name: BerryVM
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: A Windows XP-styled desktop in one tab: wallpaper, Start menu, taskbar and desktop icons, with a local-only My Computer file picker, a berry sftp remote file browser, a berry ssh terminal and a real local Command Prompt, Notepad, a picture viewer, a Linux-shaped home with alias and profile support, a Web Browser, Paint, a Media Player and a Control Panel - the multi-tab Display Properties with selectable themes, sliders and toggles. Files move between My Computer and berry sftp by drag-and-drop or Copy/Paste. Windows snap to half, quarter or full by their title bar, and the taskbar right-clicks into cascade, tile and Show desktop - all dressed up with an XP boot screen, a welcome login with its own accounts, a power-off cycle and a few XP easter eggs.

addons.name: Certificate manager
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Shows the certificate on the device as a tidy summary or the raw openssl text, and reissues the .crt and .key over SSH, with the subject, paths and follow-up commands kept in addons/_data/cert_manager/config.json.

addons.name: Multi SSH
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Opens as many SSH sessions as you like in sub-tabs, each on a connection of its own, with quickstart entries that ask only for a password and one field that types a command into every session at once.

addons.name: OpenWrt Log Viewer
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: a single-device log viewer and a multi-device view, colour-coded connections, the log in time order. The search highlights or filters the matching lines.

addons.name: OpenWrt Package Manager
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Audits installed OpenWrt packages and manages software installation via apk or opkg.

addons.name: Password manager
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Keeps logins in one encrypted file on this computer - no device, no cloud - unlocked for the session with a master password, with a searchable list, bullets until you ask to see them, a generator, and a copied password taken back off the clipboard after the seconds you configured.
